title: 给这个agentloop 做一个UI，你可以设计一个产品形态，核心功能就是任务的管理，包括CRUD，且需要能看到任务的最新进展和 runtime 的返回

goal.raw_request: 给这个agentloop 做一个UI，你可以设计一个产品形态，核心功能就是任务的管理，包括CRUD，且需要能看到任务的最新进展和 runtime 的返回

acceptance_criteria.description: The UI provides a task list that reads existing AgentLoop tasks from `.agentloop/tasks`, shows each task's id, title, status, phase, iteration progress, updated time, and clearly indicates the current task when known.
acceptance_criteria.verification: functional test or browser smoke test
acceptance_criteria.evidence: build_task_list and the UI task list read .agentloop/tasks and expose task_id, title, status, current_phase, iteration/max_iterations, updated_at, current marker, and lock/error state. Covered by test_task_list_marks_current_and_handles_malformed_state and HTTP /api/tasks coverage.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can create a new task from the UI by entering a task request; creation uses AgentLoop's existing task start behavior and results in a new task directory with `state.json`, `analysis.md`, `acceptance.md`, and `acceptance.json`.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: create_task uses start_task and produces the expected task artifacts. Covered by test_create_task_uses_workflow_artifacts and POST /api/tasks integration coverage.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can open a task detail view that shows the task request/title, status, current phase, iteration count, approval requirement, phase statuses, acceptance criteria, and available artifact links or previews.
acceptance_criteria.verification: functional test or browser smoke test
acceptance_criteria.evidence: build_task_detail returns task title/request, status, phase, iteration count, approval flag, phase statuses, acceptance criteria, artifact previews, runtime, config, and actions; the Overview, Artifacts, Config, and Runtime tabs render these fields. Covered by UI/API detail tests and source review.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can update supported per-task settings from the UI, at minimum `max_iterations` and `test_commands`, using existing AgentLoop config validation and persisting changes to the task's `config.json`.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PATCH /api/tasks/<task_id>/config supports max_iterations and test_commands and persists them to the per-task config.json through existing validation paths. Covered by test_patch_config_and_delete_task and HTTP integration coverage.

acceptance_criteria.description: A user can delete a task from the UI after explicit confirmation; the task disappears from the list and its task directory is removed using the same safety boundaries as existing task deletion behavior.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: DELETE /api/tasks/<task_id> requires exact task id confirmation, removes the task directory within the .agentloop/tasks boundary, and rejects incorrect confirmation. Covered by test_patch_config_and_delete_task and HTTP integration coverage.

acceptance_criteria.description: The UI exposes valid lifecycle actions for the selected task, including approve when waiting for alignment, cancel when cancellable, and run/resume when ready, while disabling or explaining invalid actions based on current status.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: available_actions exposes approve, run, cancel, delete, and config action state with disabled reasons when invalid or locked. Covered by test_actions_reflect_status and source review of lifecycle buttons.

acceptance_criteria.description: The UI shows the latest task progress after lifecycle actions by refreshing persisted state fields, including status, current phase, phase statuses, iteration/max iteration, and acceptance criteria statuses.
acceptance_criteria.verification: functional test or browser smoke test
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Lifecycle API mutations return fresh task detail and the frontend reloads task list/detail after approve, run, and cancel. Action state transition after approve is covered by test_actions_reflect_status.

acceptance_criteria.description: The UI shows runtime return information for the latest relevant iteration, including role, runtime, command when available, exit code, duration when available, produced artifacts, and readable stdout/stderr log content or clear missing-log messages.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: latest_runtime_summary returns latest iteration agent entries with role, runtime, adapter, command, exit_code, duration_ms, artifacts, bounded stdout, and bounded stderr; renderRuntime displays this data. Covered by test_detail_includes_artifacts_runtime_and_test_logs.

acceptance_criteria.description: The UI shows local test command output for the latest iteration when present, including command, exit code, duration, and log content from `.agentloop/runs/<task_id>/<iteration>/tests/`.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Iteration 2 now merges structured review test_results with latest iteration test logs and renders command, exit_code, duration_ms, and log content. Covered by test_detail_merges_structured_test_result_metadata, test_detail_includes_structured_test_result_with_missing_log, and full-suite execution.

acceptance_criteria.description: The implementation handles missing or malformed task files, missing artifacts, empty runtime logs, and long logs without crashing; long log content is bounded in the UI.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Malformed task state, missing logs, missing artifacts, and long logs are handled with error or missing payloads and bounded_text/bounded_workspace_file limits. Covered by malformed-state and missing-log tests plus source review.

acceptance_criteria.description: Core task UI data-loading and mutation paths are covered by tests that use temporary workspaces and do not depend on a user's real `.agentloop` data.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Core UI/API loading and mutation tests use TemporaryDirectory workspaces and do not depend on the user's real .agentloop data. Both focused and full automated suites passed with exit_code 0.

acceptance_criteria.description: The UI is task-management first: first screen is the usable task console, not a marketing page, and it uses clear controls for task CRUD, lifecycle actions, progress, and runtime output.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Manual source review of index.html, app.js, and styles.css confirms the first screen is a task-management console with task list, create, search/filter, detail, CRUD/lifecycle controls, config, artifacts, progress, and runtime output rather than a marketing page.
